'''Joeyo''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Puncharoo]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Don't raise your voice, or you'll have a shaking, crying, startled Joeyo on your hands blindly throwing out punches. Somehow, enemies get sent flying anyway."

Joeyo is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A frightened baby kangaroo that holds a red boxing glove and has a tear in its eye. It's orange-brown with a cream-white underside, and the tips of its ears and tail are dark brown. It also has blue eyes and a large, dark nose.

Joeyo's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its red boxing glove to bright blue.

== Evolution Trial ==
Joeyo's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Puncharoo]] you need to complete the following task:
* Defeat 30 enemies in [[Island Goldrush]]. Time for some courage!

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "When cornered by [[Zobos]], Joeyo hides behind the big, red glove and hopes not to be seen."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Despite having a pair of boxing gloves, Joeyo is a shy one who hides in a bag and sniffles when picked on."
